name: Ryoujoku Onna Kyoushi ~Reijin Tenraku Hen~
original_name: 凌辱女教師　～麗人転落篇～
source:
Main character graduates from school, but does not know what to do afterwards. In front of him a mysterious woman appears giving instructions on the secret technique of pretending to be a woman. He decides to pass as a noble female teacher to reach the school teacher he lusts for.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从学校毕业了，但不知道毕业后该做什么。就在这时，一个神秘的女人出现在他面前，传授他伪装成女性的秘术。他决定假扮成一位高贵的女教师，以此接近他垂涎已久的学校老师。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
